title: Generating Concept Lexicalizations via Dictionary-Based Cross-Lingual Sense Projection
abstract: arXiv:2604.14397v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the task of automatically expanding WordNet-style lexical resources to new languages through sense generation. We generate senses by associating target-language lemmas with existing lexical concepts via semantic projection. Given a sense-tagged English corpus and its translation, our method projects the annotated synsets onto aligned target-language tokens and assigns the corresponding lemmas to those synsets. To generate alignments and ensure their quality, we augment a pretrained base aligner with a bilingual dictionary, which is also used to filter incorrect sense projections. We evaluate the method on multiple languages, comparing it to prior methods, as well as dictionary-based and large language model baselines. Results show that the proposed project-and-filter strategy improves precision while remaining interpretable and resource- efficient. We release our code, documentation, and generated sense inventories at

translated_title: 基于词典的跨语言词义投影生成概念词汇化
translated_abstract: 我们研究通过词义生成来自动将WordNet风格的词汇资源扩展到新语言的任务。我们通过语义投影将目标语言的词条与现有词汇概念相关联来生成词义。给定一个带有词义标注的英语语料库及其翻译，我们的方法将标注好的同义词集（synsets）投影到对齐的目标语言词汇上，并将相应的词条分配给这些同义词集。为了生成对齐并确保其质量，我们使用双语词典对预训练的基础对齐器进行增强，该词典还用于过滤不正确的词义投影。我们在多种语言上对该方法进行评估，并与先前的方法、基于词典的基线以及大型语言模型基线进行比较。结果表明，所提出的投影-过滤策略在保持可解释性和资源高效性的同时提高了精确率。我们发布了代码、文档和生成的词义清单。
tldr: 提出一种用双语词典增强对齐器并结合过滤策略的跨语言词义投影方法，能够将WordNet式词汇资源自动扩展到新语言，在保持可解释性和资源高效的同时提升精确率。
en_tdlr: Proposes a cross-lingual sense projection method enhanced with a bilingual dictionary and a filtering strategy to automatically extend WordNet-style lexical resources to new languages, improving precision while remaining interpretable and resource-efficient.
